ScsUnitTypeCheckBypass.name: Bypass Plugin
ScsUnitTypeCheckBypass.description: Lets modified or unexpected unit types work in a save file without the game rejecting them.

PrismCacheFix.name: Prism Cache Fix
PrismCacheFix.description: Clears the in-game cache when you reload your save or use the game command. Useful for local modding and save editing.

InteriorRenderPlugin.name: Interior Render Plugin
InteriorRenderPlugin.description: Hides the original interior and steering wheel while addon hookups keep rendering and animating. Useful for local mods.

AnimatedSteeringWheel.name: Animated Steering Wheel
AnimatedSteeringWheel.description: Lets the steering wheel move up and down like in a real truck. Works on all vehicles in the game, including modded vehicles.

ScsSDKPopupBypass.name: SCS SDK Popup Bypass
ScsSDKPopupBypass.description: Skips the warning popup about plugins being enabled that shows on every game launch. One less prompt when the game loads.
